preamble.title: gendo/vault
preamble.description: Budgeted on-chain accounts for AI agents: an m-of-n vault that grants agents capped allowances

cardano/transaction/OutputReference.title: OutputReference
cardano/transaction/OutputReference.description:
An `OutputReference` is a unique reference to an output on-chain. The `output_index`
 corresponds to the position in the output list of the transaction (identified by its id)
 that produced that output

anyOf.title: CoSignedSpend
anyOf.description: Agent plus owner threshold in the same tx, beyond limits.

anyOf.title: OwnerManage
anyOf.description:
Owner threshold alone: treasury moves, config updates, allowance
 edits and reclaims. Never decodes an allowance datum.

anyOf.title: AgentTrade
anyOf.description:
Agent alone, within limits, placing orders through one app that is
 enabled on the vault and granted to it; that app's adapter checks the
 orders. Appended last: constructor indices must not move.
